title: Worth the money!
text:
Truly worth the extra cost. In a group of up to six people (our tour was just the two of us!), a guide takes you through the building hitting the places everyone sees plus a few extras that others miss. Of particular note was a ride on the original elevator, which is a very interesting wood-lined cabin with a bench (used to take minutes to ride to the top so apparently people needed a bench to sit on during the ride!), and the ability to get inside rooms that otherwise others could just peek into.
